column1: # R03: GTR + G4, strict clock (estimated), coalescent exponential, tip dates (Dengue4.env.nex).
# The 2.7.9 side uses SSM's GTR. Unlike R01, its rates prior was set in BEAUti to Dirichlet(1,...,1)
# with sum = 1 (initial values 1/6), so the rates sum to 1 in both versions and are compared
# without rescaling. The gamma-shape prior is Exponential(1) with offset 0.1 in 2.7.9, which equals
# BEAST 3's TruncatedReal(Exponential(1), lower 0.1). With both changes the log prior is the same
# function in both versions (checked to 1e-14 on 10,002 BEAST 3 samples), so `prior` and
# `posterior` are compared directly, with no constant offset.
